analysis: The PR changes only test files. FlintAnswerStopTests.swift (head line 128) and FlintResponseFormatTests.swift (hunk at line 361) each add a `.toolCallDelta` case to a test-local event-recording switch. The case counts a call only when `delta.completed` is non-nil. These additions make the switches exhaustive after the MLXLMServer event enum gained a `.toolCallDelta` case. No production code in this batch changes, so there is no change to authorization, attestation, encryption, the coordinator-provider WebSocket, App Attest authorization, fan helper, or prefix-cache storage. The Flint answer-stop tests cover token-constraint and stream-filter behavior (stop text in reasoning and tool arguments is not matched; holdback is bounded; admission limits). They do not touch T-041 SSD cache paths or key handling. Not visible in this batch: the production `.toolCallDelta` event emission and handling, and whether streaming partial tool-call deltas could leak content that the stop filter would otherwise strip. That is production code outside the supplied evidence, so it is recorded as an unverified contract rather than a finding. No security regression was identified in the test changes.
